description: This file implements the TTSURLConstructer class, which constructs URLs for Text-to-Speech services, including handling HTTP GET and POST requests, string sanitization, and URL parameter assembly.

classes.name: TTSURLConstructer
classes.description: Class responsible for constructing TTS service URLs, handling HTTP communication, and sanitizing input strings.

methods.name: constructURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL based on configuration, text, and context (fallback/local).

methods.name: httpgetURL
methods.description: Builds a URL for HTTP GET request with parameters.

methods.name: httppostURL
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to obtain a TTS URL or fallback.

methods.name: replaceIfIsolated
methods.description: Replaces a substring only if it is isolated (not part of another word).

methods.name: isSilentPunctuation
methods.description: Checks if a character is considered silent punctuation.

methods.name: replaceSuccesivePunctuation
methods.description: Removes successive silent punctuation characters from a string.

methods.name: curlSanitize
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe URL transmission using libcurl.

methods.name: sanitizeString
methods.description: Sanitizes input string by replacing certain substrings and escaping special characters.
